{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
'''''Saving Grace''''' was an automated [[Corellia/Legends|Corellian]] exploration vessel. At some point it explored the unremarkable [[Comet/Legends|comet]] [[Resh 9376/Legends|Resh 9376]]. It performed full scanning, took dozens of samples and made a holomap of the comet, all in twenty-two minutes. Then it broadcast all data to Corellia in a burst transmission and moved to its next destination. The data was briefly analyzed by [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] astronomers, then filed away and forgotten.
